scripts.setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const ex=fs.readFileSync('.env.example','utf8');for(const f of ['.env','apps/api/.env','packages/database/.env']){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){fs.writeFileSync(f,ex);console.log('created ' + f + ' from .env.example');}}" && docker compose up -d postgres && corepack pnpm --filter database exec prisma generate && corepack pnpm db:push && corepack pnpm --filter database exec prisma db seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "corepack pnpm --filter api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter public-portal dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter api build && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal build
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter api test && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal test
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter api lint && corepack pnpm --filter public-portal lint
